flows.name: Seller joins the waitlist
flows.trigger: Clicks 'Join Waitlist' in the nav or the Early Adaptors CTA (often arriving from a WhatsApp link on mobile)
steps: Land on S-001 (or arrive directly at S-002 via shared link); language auto-applies from localStorage or default
Open S-002; read the 0%-offer brand panel; press 'Get started →'
Step 1/4: pick business type (Store / Garage / Distributor) — auto-advances
Step 2/4: enter business name (required; label/placeholder adapts to type) and optional contact name
Step 3/4: optionally enter email / phone / WhatsApp / city — format-validated only when filled, inline errors in active language
Step 4/4: optionally pick monthly volume, tools (garage) or brands carried, Net-30 interest, free-text message; press Submit
Client validates + honeypot check; submission POSTs to the lead endpoint; server validates, persists, notifies the founding team
On success: S-003 panel with personalized thank-you; optionally 'Chat on WhatsApp' (prefilled wa.me message) or 'Back to Mobeeli'
On failure: retriable error shown, entered data preserved
flows.outcome: Lead persisted and delivered to founders; seller optionally continues in WhatsApp

flows.name: Buyer requests launch notification
flows.trigger: Buyer strip 'Get notified' button on the landing page
steps: Click 'Get notified' → mail client opens to info@mobeeli.com with the approved buyer subject
Send email; founders reply at launch
flows.outcome: Buyer email reaches the founding team inbox

flows.name: Investor requests the deck
flows.trigger: Investors section CTA or founder email links
steps: Navigate to #investors (nav link or hero 'For investors' CTA)
Read the traction copy (9 of 14 signed)
Click 'Request the deck' → mailto info@mobeeli.com with deck-request subject, or email a founder directly (matheau@ / hafizh@ / ferdi@)
flows.outcome: Deck request lands in the founders' inbox; follow-up is manual

flows.name: Visitor switches language
flows.trigger: EN/ID pill toggle on either page
steps: All i18n-keyed text swaps instantly (including 3D scene labels, AI status chip, wizard labels/placeholders/errors, success copy, WhatsApp message template)
Choice persists to localStorage and html lang updates; subsequent visits and the other page honor it
flows.outcome: Entire experience runs in the chosen language until changed
